dedupe_keys.name: russian port logistics relational data layer

description: This MIT-licensed Python project prepares relational inputs for a proposed Russian maritime freight model. Its public tree lists SQLAlchemy tables for basins, ports, operators, services, container lines, turnover, cargo, incidents and risks, plus scripts to initialize, load and export a database. The README reports five maritime basins and 19 ports, with about 175 operators and more than 80 incident records, and the tree contains an XLSX export. These counts and the assertion that records are verified come from the project; the underlying source documents were not cited or checked. Geographic scope is Russia, while dates and resolution of the turnover and incident entries are not established by the opened text. Public code is free under MIT. A modeller could adapt the schema as input preparation for port-network flow or corridor-disruption scenarios. The graph-weight and forecast modules are future work, not available functions. This review did not read the XLSX or run scripts. The README installation command is incomplete. Related resources are original port and incident registries, whose rights and provenance require separate checks.
